trechos: O volume representa alta de 20,3% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025, informou nesta 3ª feira (3.nov.2026) a Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis.

trechos: Intel Stock Had Its Worst Day Since 1974 Despite 8th Straight Guidance Beat.
On October 29, Intel (INTC) reported its third-quarter results.
Revenue rose 21% to $16.5 billion, and adjusted EPS of $0.52 came in well above the roughly $0.40 analysts expected.
The data center business grew 78%, its best growth in 15 years.
CEO Lip-Bu Tan said the biggest priority is increasing supply capacity to meet "extraordinary demand" for its Xeon chips.
Despite all this, Intel's stock fell about 29% in a single trading session, its worst day since 1974.

itens.titulo: Analyst sends big warning on gold and bitcoin amid U.S. midterms
itens.descricao: Analyst sends big warning on gold and bitcoin amid U.S. midterms Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: According to Bloomberg Intelligence's senior commodity strategist Mike McGlone, the Bitcoin-gold ratio was hovering around 20 ounces of gold per Bitcoin on Oct.
He believes there is a risk of the ratio falling towards 15 than climbing towards 25.
While investors have accumulated gold for centuries, Bitcoin is a relatively new asset, but its proponents call it "digital gold" because its supply is also limited like the bullion.
A drop in the Bitcoin-gold ratio from 20 to 15 would suggest investors are finding gold more attractive than BTC, McGlone suggested.
Bitcoin gained strength against gold in 2021 on the back of a major monetary stimulus, McGlone underlined.
But since then, the cryptocurrency's 260-day volatility has averaged roughly three times that of gold over the past five years, he added.

He highlighted the historical relationship between the Bitcoin-gold ratio and the Nasdaq-100, he suggested that weakness in Bitcoin relative to gold could signal fading investor appetite for risk, potentially creating pressure on tech stocks.
If the Bitcoin-gold ratio can't hold above 20, it reinforces the notion that gold is becoming the preferred safe haven among investors willing to bet on risk assets.

itens.titulo: Palantir's AI demand is accelerating, but its backlog tells a more complicated story
itens.descricao: Palantir's AI demand is accelerating, but its backlog tells a more complicated story Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: Palantir Technologies Inc (NYSE:PLTR) shares fell 2% on Tuesday afternoon as investors weighed record revenue growth against signs of moderating contract momentum, despite continued support from Wall Street analysts.

The artificial intelligence software company reported 96% year-over-year revenue growth in the third quarter of 2026, accelerating by three percentage points from the previous quarter, with revenue rising a record $378 million sequentially.
UBS said revenue growth was outstanding, with the company delivering a 6.9% beat against expectations.
US commercial revenue growth reached 148%, while total US revenue growth accelerated to 119% from 115% in the second quarter.
The main concern was remaining performance obligations (RPO), a measure of contracted revenue yet to be recognized, which was flat sequentially for the first time since the first quarter of 2023.
Palantir attributed the moderation partly to shorter contract durations among sovereign AI customers, which can sign agreements of less than 12 months that are not reflected in RPO.
The bank raised its 2027 revenue growth estimate to 70% from 60% and increased its free cash flow forecast to $8.92 billion from $8.18 billion.
It maintained a $250 price target, arguing that Palantir's growth and profitability justify its valuation premium.
